summary: Trap Statistics Tracking and Community Learning features fully tested. All 19 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI working correctly for both features. Minor data quality issue found: community puzzle share API accepts invalid FEN strings without validation.

minor.issue: API accepts puzzles with invalid FEN strings - should validate FEN format before storing

integration_issues.issue: When selecting a puzzle with invalid FEN, chess board throws 'Invalid FEN: piece data is invalid' error. Root cause is backend accepting invalid FEN in share endpoint.
integration_issues.priority: LOW - data validation issue, not frontend bug

trap_statistics_record_attempt.description: Records trap attempts for execution/avoidance/recognition modes with success/failure tracking

trap_statistics_get_stats.description: Returns total_attempts, total_successes, success_rate, traps map, weakest_traps, strongest_traps, recent_activity

trap_statistics_recommendations.description: Returns personalized trap recommendations with trap_key, name, reason, priority (high/medium)

trap_stats_ui_my_statistics.description: My Statistics button with success rate badge (75% success) visible in Trick Library section

trap_stats_ui_panel.description: Trap Statistics panel shows Total Attempts, Successes, Success Rate cards plus Areas to Improve, Your Strengths, Recent Activity sections

trap_stats_ui_recommendations.description: Recommended for You section shows 3 trap recommendations with priority badges (high/medium)

trap_stats_ui_per_trap_badges.description: Individual trap items in Trick Library show success rate percentage badges

community_share_puzzle.description: Shares puzzles to community with fen, best_move_san, issue_type, difficulty, theme

community_get_puzzles.description: Returns puzzle list with filters (difficulty, sort_by), includes puzzle_id, fen, best_move_san, attempts, solve_rate, user_solved

community_attempt_puzzle.description: Validates user move, returns correct/incorrect with expected_move and message

community_rate_puzzle.description: Allows rating puzzles 1-5 stars, updates avg_rating

community_ui_tab.description: Community tab visible on Training page alongside Puzzles and Opening Trainer tabs

community_ui_stats_card.description: Community Stats card shows Puzzles count (2) and Solve Rate (66.7%)

community_ui_puzzle_list.description: Puzzle list shows difficulty badges (beginner/intermediate), attempts, solve rates, user_solved checkmarks

community_ui_puzzle_solving.description: Selected puzzle shows chess board, 'Your Turn' badge, 'Playing as white' indicator, Puzzle Info panel
